contentPattern.structure: repeating label/value rows rendered as a vertical spec list with left accent rule

suitableFor: adventure/product detail spec panels (Activity, Trip Length, Group Size, Difficulty, Price)
key/value fact sheets shown as a vertical label-over-value stack
at-a-glance sidebars pairing an uppercase label with a bold value
notSuitableFor: two-column text + media feature layouts (use columns-media)
contact lists with intro copy (use columns-contact)
repeating card grids or image galleries
